description: Secretaria do Verde e do Meio Ambiente (SVMA), City of São Paulo publishes the georeferenced register of squares and open spaces (praças e largos) of the municipality, one of the instruments of participatory square management under municipal law 16.212/2015, with a data dictionary and metadata in several formats and CSV and GeoPackage files. Coverage: the municipality of São Paulo; the page says updated on 11/11/2025 on demand, and the portal record was modified on 2026-07-08. Format and access: CSV, GPKG, ODS, XLS, downloadable without registration from the São Paulo municipal open data portal; the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Creative Commons CCZero; cost: free. Caveats: the description states the purpose (planning creation, expansion and maintenance of public spaces and updating the public green area indicator) but not the number of squares; the files were not opened and the attributes are unconfirmed. Simulation uses: public-space layers for urban heat, flood-retention and green-infrastructure studies and for accessibility and open-space shelter analysis. Related catalogue records: OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
